what: Cognizant is an information technology services company. It builds, runs and modernises the software systems of large corporations, with most of its delivery workforce in India and much of its revenue from North American clients.
customers: Banks and insurers, healthcare and life sciences companies, retailers, manufacturers and media businesses, mostly in North America.
money: technology services to banks and insurers
services to healthcare payers, providers and pharmaceutical companies
retail, manufacturing, energy and travel clients
moat: Long-running contracts that embed it in clients' core operations, with an India-based delivery cost structure that US competitors cannot match directly.
risks: Client technology budgets have been tight
Artificial intelligence could reduce the number of people needed per project, which is how this industry bills
US immigration policy affects its staffing model
Staff attrition rises whenever the labour market tightens
opportunities: Revenue grew about 7% last year with a 16% operating margin
Analysts see about 21% upside from current levels
Companies rebuilding systems around artificial intelligence need exactly this implementation work
watch: Bookings growth and revenue growth in constant currency.
